verdict.rationale: The evidence shows programmatic ways to act on many records at once. The CLI is aimed at scripts and CI workflows and manages indices, settings, rules and synonyms. The Search API manages indices and records, and scheduled data pipelines and the Crawler ingest and turn content into records in bulk. None of the evidence explicitly documents batch or bulk-update operations across many items. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented batch/bulk-operation API or CLI command, bulk update/delete semantics, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
